description.narrative: Resultatet Målet är att säkerställa hållbara resultat som uppnåtts under den första och andra faser av samarbetet (2004-2012), i synnerhet att reglerande finansiell revision av statliga konton görs i full överensstämmelse med revisionshandledning och hanteras och dokumenteras i lagkamrat, processen-baserad programvara för finansiell revision.

The outcome objective is to ensure sustainability of results achieved during the first and second phases of the cooperation (2004-2012), in particular that regulatory financial audits of state accounts are done in full compliance with the audit manual and managed and documented in TeamMate, the process-based software for financial auditing.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: While a large number of NAOT auditors have undergone training in risk based auditing and compliance with the regulatory audit manual, it is still unclear to what extent the quality and analytical depth of the annual audits have improved. This lack of clarity is also indicative of the results situation with regard to quality assurance and revew. If it is unclear what the quality is, there is probably no adequate system and routines in place for checking and reporting on the same quality. It may of course be that the NAOT has the systems and routines in place but is reluctant to share the results, but that would also indicate that the results are actually not that good.
